defects.title: non-finite numbers were not validated: NaN mark and NaN leverage reached approvals
defects.cause: every limit used `<=` style comparisons and NaN satisfies none of them; the engine had no finiteness gate
defects.fix: engine._validate_numbers refuses any non-finite or impossible input as DATA_INVALID/INVALID_NUMERIC_INPUT; the ledger refuses non-finite amounts; cost and margin models guard their own arithmetic

defects.title: hostile numbers raised instead of refusing (NaN reached int())
defects.cause: round_quantity_down() and the funding-settlement conversion called int() on unvalidated floats
defects.fix: quantity rounding returns 0 for non-finite input (a refusal), the numeric gate rejects the request before any arithmetic, and depth levels that are not readable make the impact unknown

defects.title: a repeated decision id reserved its margin twice
defects.cause: MarginLedger.try_reserve appended a grant per call, with no identity
defects.fix: a grant for the same decision id is re-confirmed instead of counted again; a larger request for the same id is SHARED_COLLATERAL_CONFLICT
defects.counterexample: two evaluations of decision DUP-1 reserved 165 USDT for one decision

defects.title: the aggregate margin-utilization ceiling could be exceeded by concurrent decisions
defects.cause: the ceiling was enforced against each decision's snapshot, not against the live reservation, so two approvals could pass 50% together
defects.fix: the engine hands the ceiling to the ledger, which enforces it atomically under the same lock as the reservation (MARGIN_UTILIZATION_LIMIT)
defects.counterexample: two sequential decisions on a stale snapshot left 660 USDT reserved on 1000 USDT of equity (66%) with a 50% policy ceiling

defects.title: a non-finite reservation poisoned the ledger for every later decision
defects.cause: try_reserve accepted NaN and made reserved/free NaN
defects.fix: the ledger refuses non-finite amounts and non-finite equity

defects.title: an unmodelable stress scenario was silently treated as no stress
defects.cause: a NaN stress path produced a NaN liquidation price and every comparison against NaN is False, so the path was skipped
defects.fix: the engine rejects non-finite stress parameters as DATA_INVALID and the margin model refuses a stress it cannot evaluate (LIQUIDATION_RISK_UNKNOWN)

defects.title: a non-finite funding observation could corrupt the funding term
defects.cause: funding_context() trusted every row it could see
defects.fix: only finite, timestamped observations are visible point-in-time; with no usable rate left, funding is UNKNOWN and the position is refused
defects.counterexample: all-NaN funding history with a settlement in the horizon (pre-fix: 0.0 cost)

defects.title: the closed-form liquidation solve extrapolated the maintenance amount below its zero floor
defects.cause: the venue floors maintenance at max(notional*rate - cum, 0); the linear solve ignored the kink, so at the deepest bracket it returned a non-positive price and a 5 bps LARGER buffer than the true model (unsafe direction: it understated the liquidation price for a long)
defects.fix: the solve is now piecewise: each linear branch is solved and the candidate inside its own domain is kept (the floored branch when the clamp binds)
defects.counterexample: LONG, notional 999999.99, 1x: builder returned liquidation_price=0.0 while the numeric root of the floored condition gives 41.25 (5.0 bps of overstated buffer)

conclusion: PASS — no false approval survived; every invariant held under the counterexamples, the catalogue replay, the randomized search, the numeric-root liquidation cross-check and the concurrency probes.
